purpose: Frozen secondary JPL November 2019 guard ablation. It reuses the already acquired primary cohort without changing data preparation, PV proxy, feeder sensitivity, policy, or test window. The only declared condition change is unguarded versus calibration-fitted fixed-global versus previously selected multi-rate early-departure guard.

acn_data_protocol.controller_information: At plug-in use the earliest complete declared kWhRequested and requestedDeparture. The later disconnectTime is a hidden environment event and must never be a controller input.
acn_data_protocol.unclaimed_session_policy: Exclude sessions without a complete initial commitment from the primary analysis.
acn_data_protocol.target_interpretation: Service ratio is delivered energy divided by user-declared requested energy, not historical delivered energy.

commitment_uncertainty.deployment_rule: At each plug-in each guard uses only JPL April calibration scores and JPL physical unplug outcomes already observed at or before that control step.
commitment_uncertainty.selection_protocol: This is a predeclared ablation, not a new model-selection exercise. The fixed global guard is calibrated only on JPL April. The multi-rate envelope was selected and recorded on JPL May, replicated unchanged on JPL June, and audited on JPL December. JPL November is used only to compare these fixed conditions with no guard.
commitment_uncertainty.scope: Secondary ablation evidence only. Empirical coverage is operational and does not imply a finite-sample, conditional, per-driver, universal, or real-time deployment guarantee.

comparison_protocol.unit_of_inference: matched chronological calendar day; never individual EV session
comparison_protocol.shared_information_and_safety: All conditions use the same declared commitment, causal information timing, present-time PV-capacity source, station limits, synthetic feeder mapping, AC execution check, and 15-minute time step. Guarded conditions alone reduce the effective planning deadline using only their declared calibration and past unplug information.
comparison_protocol.forbidden_actions_after_acquisition: Do not alter the guard definition, learning rates, calibration period, policy, metric, target definition, station mapping, feeder cap, or test window.

charging_data.station_assignment: deterministic hash of session ID across synthetic stations
charging_data.note: Real JPL sessions are mapped to synthetic feeder stations; this is an explicit experiment assumption.

solar_data.note: Fixed regional GHI resource proxy; it is not measured JPL rooftop PV output.

pv_proxy_sensitivity.note: PVWatts GHI proxy for a controlled sensitivity experiment; it is not measured JPL PV production.

feeder_sensitivity.note: Deliberately severe synthetic shared feeder-import budget; it is not a measured JPL feeder limit.
